src/cvm-nostr-transport.ts.name: Nostr link to tool servers
src/cvm-nostr-transport.ts.description: Sends ContextVM tool requests to remote servers as Nostr events, optionally encrypted, and waits for replies within a deadline.

src/cvm-progress-controller.ts.name: Progress and chunk assembly
src/cvm-progress-controller.ts.description: Reassembles tool replies that arrive in pieces and tracks streamed progress, giving up when a stream goes quiet too long.

src/cvm-registry-types.ts.name: Trusted tool list shapes
src/cvm-registry-types.ts.description: Describes the host-configured tool families pinned to known tool fingerprints, the way a napplet picks one by family or fingerprint, and the verified tools and providers the registry returns.

src/cvm-registry.ts.name: Trusted tool lookup
src/cvm-registry.ts.description: Picks a tool from the host's trusted list, checking the provider's live tool description matches its pinned fingerprint before calling it.

src/cvm-schema-hash.ts.name: Tool fingerprint
src/cvm-schema-hash.ts.description: Computes a stable fingerprint of a tool's description so the host can tell whether a remote tool has changed.

src/cvm-service-handler.ts.name: ContextVM message handler
src/cvm-service-handler.ts.description: Answers napplet discover, request, registry and close messages, asking for approval and enforcing call limits before reaching the network.

src/cvm-service.ts.name: ContextVM service setup
src/cvm-service.ts.description: Creates the ContextVM service from a host-supplied network link, optional limits and optional trusted tool list.

src/cvm-types.ts.name: ContextVM message shapes
src/cvm-types.ts.description: Describes the tool, server and request records ContextVM messages carry between napplets and the shell.
